## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- claim-3 and claim-4 are arithmetically correct under the stated rectangular-data interpretation; the total \(60+30=90\) is correct.
- The 90 instances are only conditional \((r,q,i,j)\)-data, not yet a verified enumeration of admissible \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), because the parameter correspondence and constraints on \(s,t\) are missing.
- “Immediately beyond” is explicitly a convention; alternative bounded expansions produce different lists.
- claim-5 remains conjectural and should not be read as established minimality for any of the 90 cases.
